name: mishna-poster-generator
description: Generate printable Letter-size daily Mishnah learning posters from open-source Sefaria texts. One mishna per page, Hebrew with nikud, Bartenura commentary, custom templates, native-Hebrew mode.

scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e

comments.vendor: assets/vendor and assets/fonts are self-hosted copies of the npm packages listed above (see tools/sync-vendor.sh); the site itself has zero build step and zero runtime dependencies beyond those files.
